name: steps
need: Show where the user is in a few steps or a pipeline: done, current, upcoming, optional or in error, in a row, a column, a bar or a stage path, steps to go back to

--ds-steps-mark-size.description: a step's mark at size md (4px per size step)

--ds-steps-font.description: the type of a step (always at the regular weight; the current label takes the label weight)

--ds-steps-gap.description: the room between the steps of `.ds-steps--vertical` (2px per density step)

--ds-steps-path-height.description: a stage of `.ds-steps--path` at size md and comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

labExempt.DS.steps.position: the position a step announces, no motion of its own
